description: Election Commission - N. M. Somathilaka was Selected as a member of the Pannala Pradeshiya Sabha
categorisation: This gazette notice concerns the filling of a vacancy in a local government body (Pannala Pradeshiya Sabha) due to a resignation, which is directly related to electoral processes and local authority elections as specified under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It involves the declaration of a new member following party nomination procedures, making it clearly fall under Election-related matters.
